newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Cambodia to attend ASEAN meeting as observer.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia to attend ASEAN meeting as observer.

text.p: Cambodia is due to attend the ASEAN foreign ministerial meeting next week as an observer with a delegation headed by Foreign Minister Ung Huot, Association of South East Asian Nations Secretary-General Ajit Singh said on Friday.

Singh told a news conference: "All we know is that the observer delegation will be led by Mr Ung Huot", who was nominated earlier this week to replace ousted First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh.
ASEAN foreign ministers last week to postpone Cambodia's admission to the group due to the political turmoil in the country.

Cambodia had been due to join ASEAN together with Burma and Laos at next week's annual foreign ministerial conference in Kuala Lumpur. Three ASEAN foreign ministers were due to meet Ranariddh for talks in the Thai capital of Bangkok later on Friday.
ASEAN currently groups Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam and Brunei.

Ranariddh was overthrown by Second Prime Minister Hun Sen on July 6 after two days of bloodshed in the Cambodian capital Phnom Penh. Both his ouster and his replacement have been condemned by the United States.
